svg.text: Horizontal redraw from the actual implementation. Current runtime is React + Express + Weaviate + OpenAI on Render, not the older AWS Lambda / API Gateway / Step Functions sketch.
Served by Express from `dist/` in production
Assessment state and chat history stored in `sessionStorage`
Express 5, JSON bodies up to 50 MB, CORS, static file serving, SSE formatting via `lib/sse.mjs`
Current deployment is a long-running Node process, so streaming is done directly without serverless limits
Implemented but not wired in React:
Used by chatbot plus several generator/evaluator endpoints
URL ingest can download a PDF into `documents/` and extract Markdown preview
Final confirmation writes a registry file, then kicks `scripts/ingest.py --registry-file ...`
Triggered by admin routes or CLI
When a document is classified as `case_study`,
Parallelized with a thread pool and JSON cache
1. Curated source documents become chunked RAG records in `CoachingTool`
2. Case studies also become summarized top-level documents in `CaseStudyLibrary`
3. Admin dashboard reads counts and breakdowns from Weaviate aggregations
4. Document Explorer reads chunk metadata and can delete matching `document_id` records from both collections
C. Alternate PDF pipeline still present in the repo
This is the older PDF-oriented ingestion path referenced by `npm run pipeline` and by admin pipeline mode `source: "pdf"`.
It does not build `CaseStudyLibrary`; it writes chunked records into `CoachingTool` after structure-aware Markdown chunking.
The codebase therefore contains two ingestion families:
• Main path: `scripts/ingest.py` for registry / Excel + case-study enrichment
The horizontal diagram keeps both because both are still callable from code.
